rationale: The assistant reached the correct cause (drawer ajar) and told the customer to silence the alarm, keep the drawer shut and let it recover, with no unnecessary part or escalation. Weaknesses: the first replies were long and generic, listing sensor, board, compressor and refrigerant-leak possibilities. It used US units ('0°F' offered as -18°C equivalent, which is wrong) and gave no advice on checking partly thawed food, which the final turn omitted. It also did not ask what the display showed or about the food condition early on.
